scenarios.label: Successful payment
scenarios.description: Complete payment authorization with verified webhook receipt, automated ledger reconciliation, and immediate batch clearance.
scenarios.businessImpact: Traveller application batch fully authorized and released into border security processing stream without delay.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: E2E pass with evidence captured. Proceed with scheduled release; telemetry indicates zero anomaly.

scenarios.label: Declined payment
scenarios.description: Issuing bank declines card due to insufficient funds; downstream border batch processing is safely stopped without charging.
scenarios.businessImpact: Traveller notified in real-time with unambiguous, non-technical decline guidance and option to re-enter payment credentials.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: Expected negative result; verify customer messaging clarity, session preservation, and absence of phantom pre-auth holds.

scenarios.label: Cancelled payment
scenarios.description: Traveller voluntarily selects 'Cancel and Return to Application' on the hosted payment interface.
scenarios.businessImpact: No duplicate charge created; batch application saved in editable 'Pending Payment' state for 24 hours.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: Verify state persistence across session resumption and confirm no gateway webhook deadlock occurs.

scenarios.label: Gateway timeout
scenarios.description: Windcave upstream endpoint fails to respond within the strict 15-second mutual TLS socket timeout window.
scenarios.businessImpact: High financial risk. Uncertain gateway state could cause customer double-billing if blind automatic retries occur.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: Enforce circuit-breaker pattern. Trigger automated status inquiry query before allowing user retry.

scenarios.label: Missing callback
scenarios.description: Payment authorization succeeds at Windcave, but asynchronous HTTPS webhook callback fails due to transient firewall drop.
scenarios.businessImpact: Customer card is charged, but application remains in 'Awaiting Payment' in portal, blocking visa processing.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: Hold release until callback recovery cron polling job and duplicate-payment reconciliation controls are verified in UAT.

scenarios.label: System error before redirect
scenarios.description: Batch API validation rejects traveller payload due to malformed XML/JSON schema before redirection to gateway.
scenarios.businessImpact: Entire batch application rejected before payment page; travellers blocked from completing border declaration.
scenarios.qaRecommendation: E2E blocked; defect mapped to Build 2.1 API schema parser. Deploy hotfix and retest full regression pack.

evidence.errorDetail: SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid passport country ISO-3166 code
